observation.visible_scene: A nighttime grove/park lined with rows of slender trees. An intense, overexposed white-yellow light glows from the central background, washing the grass in bright green and leaving the sky dark. A single silhouetted person stands in the middle ground, back to the camera, facing the light.
visible_changes: The silhouetted person slowly recedes: comparing frame 1 to frame 41 the figure is slightly smaller and positioned a bit higher in the frame, and the legs alternate between apart and together poses, consistent with a slow walk away from the camera toward the bright area (not a single static stance).

The framing drifts leftward over the sequence: the central dark foreground trunk moves from about x=460 (frame 1) to about x=360 (frame 41), and the right trunk from about x=860 to x=770, indicating a slow camera pan/drift; inter-trunk spacing also changes slightly, suggesting mild perspective/zoom variation rather than a pure translation.

Tree canopies and leaves show small frame-to-frame shape changes (gentle swaying), and the bright light patch subtly changes outline/brightness while remaining large and blown-out throughout; the green-lit grass and dark sky persist.
No object appears or disappears; the person, the light, and the trees are present in every frame.
outside_clip_unknowns: The purpose or destination of the person's walk and what happens before/after this segment.
The nature/source of the bright light and whether its intensity change is real or an artifact.
Whether the walking continues beyond the last frame.
uncertain_details: Exact camera motion type (pan vs. dolly vs. handheld drift) is not fully determined from background evidence.
Whether the person's leg changes are a true walking gait or weight-shifting while nearly stationary; the net recession is small.
Whether the light-patch shape changes are physical flicker, leaf occlusion, or compression noise.
